answer: At dawn agents must launch a zephyr through the falcon’s hollow knoll, timing its echo return between 89 ms and 91 ms; any zephyr that’s too early or late fails, and the knoll resets its reed gate, forcing a new falcon flight per head. A Sybil needing 100 zephyrs must wait 100 fresh dawns—the knoll’s reed gate wears at 89-91 ms pace, no mass threads allowed.
